baseline_facts.fact: The selected source is TRD-20260928-92C32D18 revision 2, trd_done, with 31 requirements and no recorded open questions or assumptions.

The active interpreter reports Python 3.12.13; the current frontend package/BUILD declares Node 25.9.0, npm 11.12.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, Vite 8.3.0 and Cytoscape 3.34.3. No build or install was run during planning.

baseline_facts.evidence_locator: depot/projects.json; direct existence inspection of project.json
baseline_facts.fact: The root has no project.json. The factual registry identifies sys4ai-depot at . and the separate Template and Mathematics projects.

The current Service starts its worker and waits for ontology-derived readiness before binding HTTP; the worker leases SnapshotStore immediately. The frontend start() waits for ontology context before navigation.

Existing route destinations are overview, terms, processes, entry, process and map. Existing frontend modules already provide source drawers, safe controls, relationship lists, lazy graph rendering and request-state handling.

The initializer supports project.json fields project_id, project_name, purpose and relative_path, preserves existing values and confines destinations beneath Projects. The depot root is outside that initializer destination scope.

Current starter selection lacks app root files. Template distribution has source mode handling, while ordinary initializer writes default new files to 0644; launcher delivery therefore needs explicit executable-mode ownership.

Available existing checks include Explorer asset/session/security/read/search/source/service tests and initializer fixtures. They were inventoried, not executed; the old full-release verification remains incomplete.

baseline_facts.evidence_locator: git branch --show-current; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all
baseline_facts.fact: The repository is on main at 96f06791c0e8ec72750b242728de363fd5641b5b. The first full status observation contained 39331 entries: one pre-existing tracked modification and 39330 untracked entries; a later preservation snapshot contained 39332 entries. No staging or Git publication is authorized.

Plan catalog inspection found 14 managed plans and no matching shared Project-app plan. Task startup reported two awaiting_user Tasks and a historical staged-response warning, with no ledger mutation or required recovery; none was selected.

The configured Curator checkpoint recorded one transport observation, zero canonical writes and pending_owner/runtime_unavailable; pending maintenance was preserved. This provides no maintenance completion proof.

constraints: Use the approved TRD as the complete scope baseline; keep all 31 original IDs, outcomes, acceptances and dependencies.
Author reusable changes in sources; let the Template updater own generated Template copies; use an exact separate root adoption manifest.
Preserve source-owner permissions and current package/guard/session controls; browsing must not dispatch canonical mutations.
Use the existing prepared toolchain and pinned dependencies; a missing build prerequisite needs its own authority before installation.
Execution must follow the applicable Task workflow and fresh role ownership rules; this plan does not activate a Task or native goal.
Use only minimum shared evidence. No broad suites, voice/screen-reader/certification, platform matrices, stress/benchmark or native-agent pilot campaigns.
All task artifact paths are proposed exact file sets or bounded package ownership areas to freeze in TASK-001; no parallel write groups are claimed.

guidance.summary: Evidence-based scoped work, source-first planning, proportionate checks and truthful verification levels.
Depot Director owns framing and asset adoption; delegated inspection grants no Task writer authority.
Source collections, Template and project-local copies are distinct; Task/TRD/plan activation is explicit.
Current runtime, Explorer, owner interfaces and initialization/delivery boundaries.
TO-IP-001 creation through plan_state.py only; exact revision approval is required for ready.
Clear, source-grounded technical prose and context for unfamiliar readers.
Template maintains its generic governance, explicit task ownership and neutral starter boundaries.

requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 7.1, APP-004.

acceptance_criteria: Items identify the affected record, recorded issue or next step, source and observation time. The page distinguishes no recorded items from unavailable or partial coverage and invents no urgency, deadlines, risk score or app-owned attention ledger.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 7.1 and 7.3, APP-008 and APP-009.

acceptance_criteria: Copy supplies necessary context, describes real actions, preserves source meaning and uncertainty, and avoids unsupported promotional claims. Errors explain the effect and a useful next step. Editorial review is a content inspection, not an AI-detector, voice or speech test.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1 and U2; H section 8, APP-005 and APP-023; S3.

acceptance_criteria: Page loads do not generate prose or overwrite custom text. Supported provenance identifies the source bytes and reviewed output; changed sources mark affected copy for review. Missing copy uses a safe labeled excerpt/draft or an explicit gap. Content derived from a no-longer-permitted source is withheld.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 7.4 and 8.2, APP-006 and APP-007.
negative_requirements: No runtime prose generation or overwrite of customized Home copy; withhold content whose source permission was withdrawn.
requirements.outcome: Keep explanatory Home content project-owned, source-linked and stable across page loads, with a visible review need when its supporting content changes.
requirements.title: Preserve reviewed project content

acceptance_criteria: A reader can navigate between available views, return Home, use browser Back/Forward and follow source links. Controls have meaningful labels and visible keyboard focus, information does not rely on color alone, and normal text resizing or a narrow window does not hide essential content. Missing modules have clear states instead of misleading working links.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1 and U2; H sections 6 and 14.2, APP-044; D3.
requirements.outcome: Provide consistent Home, Work, Project knowledge, Health and setup, Tools and help navigation, with visible Search, readable page context and ordinary usable web controls.

Existing distinctions between asserted, inferred, derived, external and historical information remain intact. Integration does not restore ontology authoring or create a permanent second copy of knowledge semantics.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 10 and 15.4, APP-014; S1 and S4.
negative_requirements: Do not restore ontology authoring or create a permanent second knowledge semantics implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Terms and processes remain readable when graph rendering is unavailable. Relationship labels and direction are understandable; owner-supplied limits or continuation are visible. Missing process details are identified rather than invented.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1 and U2; H sections 10.1 and 10.2, APP-014 and APP-017.

requirements.outcome: Expose permitted project memory through a clearly labeled Lessons and decisions view when the installed memory owner supports reading.

requirements.outcome: Provide read-only Work views for Tasks and their explicitly linked requirements, plans, deliverables and recorded evidence through supported owning interfaces.

acceptance_criteria: An approved TRD is labeled as document approval, not implemented work. An installed role or recorded assignment is not displayed as a running agent. Missing, failed, partial, stale and unexercised evidence retains that meaning; links between records require explicit references.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 9.2, APP-010, APP-011 and APP-013; S1 and S5.
negative_requirements: Do not equate approval, Task completion, recorded assignment, running agent or release evidence.
requirements.outcome: Keep requirements approval, plan state, Task completion, recorded assignments, observed agent activity and release/deployment evidence distinct.
requirements.title: Preserve the meaning of work status

acceptance_criteria: A reader can reach the supporting record and distinguish current observations from historical evidence. Unrecorded historical versions say Not recorded; a current digest is not presented as old verification evidence. Copied logical references contain no credentials and are not described as permanent live-service URLs.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 9.3, 13.2, 13.3 and 16.3, APP-016 and APP-046.
negative_requirements: No credentials in copied references; no current digest presented as historical verification.
requirements.outcome: Attach useful source references and available version, status, observation and freshness information to material work and knowledge claims, and allow permitted references to be opened or copied.
requirements.title: Make displayed information traceable

acceptance_criteria: Known IDs, titles and supported text can be found without semantic services. Results identify their type and source. The app reports failed, unsupported or partially scanned sources separately from no matches, does not widen memory's corpus, and excludes unapproved child-project and collaboration content.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 13, APP-025 and APP-026; S1.
negative_requirements: No semantic-service requirement, memory corpus expansion, unapproved child-project search or collaboration content.
requirements.outcome: Provide one typed lexical search across supported permitted project documents, work and knowledge, using each source owner's scope.
requirements.title: Search permitted project information

acceptance_criteria: Installed, configured, disabled, incompatible, unavailable and not checked states remain distinguishable, as do static checks and runtime observations. A deliberately disabled optional feature is not presented as an emergency. Health uses existing owners and creates no new maintenance queue or repair loop.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 12, APP-022, APP-023 and APP-051; S1.
negative_requirements: No new maintenance queue, repair loop or emergency label for an intentionally disabled optional feature.
requirements.outcome: Show the actual availability of installed capabilities and relevant existing Curator/setup notices with understandable effects and recovery guidance.
requirements.title: Explain health and setup

acceptance_criteria: Entries explain purpose, inputs, outputs and limits. Help covers starting/stopping the app, finding knowledge, understanding a blocked Task and resolving setup issues. A control that only copies an instruction says so; it does not claim to run a skill, start an agent or grant authority.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 12.3, APP-024.
negative_requirements: Copying an instruction never runs a skill, starts an agent or grants authority.
requirements.outcome: Explain installed skills, valid roles and ordinary app use in a small Tools and help view, with instructions that match the installed capability.
requirements.title: Provide useful tools and help

acceptance_criteria: The core page does not require an ontology snapshot, semantic backend, graph renderer or native agent session. requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 12.1, 15.4 and 16, APP-043.
negative_requirements: Home must not require ontology snapshots, semantic backends, graph rendering or native agent sessions.
requirements.outcome: Keep Home, navigation and available sources usable when an optional knowledge, memory, search or health integration is absent or unavailable.
requirements.title: Contain optional failures

acceptance_criteria: These operations do not create, close, resume or repair Tasks; approve documents; publish memory/ontology; acknowledge collaboration; rebuild governed indexes; or run maintenance. Only documented app-owned transient/session state and harmless presentation preferences may change.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 18.2, APP-021 and APP-037; S1, S4 and S5.
negative_requirements: No canonical Task/TRD/plan/memory/ontology/collaboration mutation, acknowledgement, index rebuild or maintenance during reading.
requirements.outcome: Leave governed project records unchanged during launch, browsing, search, source viewing, refresh, reading-session closure and app shutdown.
requirements.title: Keep browsing read-only

acceptance_criteria: The browser cannot select an arbitrary root or file, gain access through project registration, execute unknown project code during discovery, or expose unsupported collaboration metadata. Each optional integration remains confined to the selected project and its owner's permitted sources.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 11.1, 13, 15.4, 16 and 18.1, APP-018, APP-019, APP-027, APP-033, APP-042 and APP-050; S1, S2 and S4.
negative_requirements: No arbitrary browser-selected root/file, implicit authority from registration, unknown project code execution or collaboration metadata disclosure.
requirements.outcome: Apply existing root, source and reader permissions to every displayed record, preview, search result, count and cached response, using reviewed compatible read integrations.
requirements.title: Preserve project and source boundaries

acceptance_criteria: Project content cannot execute as trusted app code, credentials do not enter ordinary copied links or diagnostics, and late or revoked responses cannot replace current permitted content. Changed routes/rendering use the same protections as the existing reader; no new broad security certification is implied.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 16.3 and 18.1, APP-034 and APP-053; S1 and S4.
negative_requirements: No trusted execution of project content, leaked credentials or late/revoked content replacing current permitted views.
requirements.outcome: Retain the existing local reader's loopback, session, request-origin, safe-content rendering and stale-response protections when integrating new pages.
requirements.title: Preserve safe local reading

acceptance_criteria: A prepared project can use Home and available reading features without a remote service or live depot process. requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 15.1, 17.2 and 18.1, APP-028; S1 and S4.
negative_requirements: No required cloud service, remote asset, model call, install/build, optional-backend startup, Template apply or background-service installation at launch.
requirements.outcome: Serve the ordinary app from reviewed local assets without required cloud services, remote assets, runtime model calls, dependency installation or optional-service startup.
requirements.title: Keep ordinary use local

acceptance_criteria: On the initially supported macOS host, double-clicking the prepared project's launcher needs no typed command and resolves the project relative to that launcher. negative_requirements: Do not connect to another project, kill an unrelated process or require Python to read missing-runtime guidance.
requirements.outcome: Provide a project-local Launch Project entry point that opens the correct Home page after the owned app is ready and safely reopens a compatible running instance.
requirements.title: Open the correct Home page easily

acceptance_criteria: Tab closure makes no service-stop claim. Close reading session revokes that session; Stop app affects only the owned reader and explains the effect on its other tabs. Neither stops Tasks, agents, watchers or independent backends. Shutdown uncertainty is labeled honestly, package replacement requires restart, and no short reading-session timeout is added.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 17.5, APP-031; S4.
negative_requirements: No service-stop claim from tab closure, no stopping Tasks/agents/watchers/backends, and no short reading-session timeout.
requirements.outcome: Distinguish closing a tab, closing the reading session and stopping the selected project's owned app service, while preserving supported reading-session behavior.
requirements.title: Make session and service controls clear

acceptance_criteria: New-project setup can select the same reviewed package and bind the destination's own identity/content. Template starters contain no actual depot prose, Task history, memory records, grants, credentials or runtime state; setup does not claim that static installation proves a running app.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H section 19.1 and 19.2, APP-038 and APP-048; S1 and S2.
negative_requirements: No depot prose, actual records, grants, credentials or runtime state in neutral starters.
requirements.outcome: Distribute the shared app package, launcher, setup guidance and neutral content/configuration starters through the existing reusable-source, Template and initializer ownership routes.
requirements.title: Supply reusable neutral starters

acceptance_criteria: Adoption identifies exact destinations and owned files, preserves customized prose/configuration and unrelated work, retains original setup editions, and records only the selected addition. Reruns do not overwrite later custom edits. Updates/recovery restore only operation-owned package/configuration changes, never older project history. Conflicts are reported through the existing owner.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and acceptance meaning. Original provenance: U1; H sections 19.3 and 19.4, APP-007, APP-039 and APP-040; S1 and S2.
negative_requirements: No implicit bulk adoption, overwritten custom copy, relabeled receipt edition, widened destination boundary or historical-state rollback.

Cross-project aggregation, unrestricted browsing, bulk adoption, existing real-product installation or widening the initializer destination boundary.
Runtime prose/model generation, cloud services, optional backend provisioning, editors/terminals, unattended scheduling and repair loops.

Voice/audio/speech, dedicated screen-reader/narration, certification, OS/browser matrices, stress/benchmarks, native-agent pilots, exhaustive optional/failure scenarios and the historical full-release test program.
